answer: Mechanism: bonded identity plus cross-examining juries. Before an agent may grade, it posts a bond of earned POA. A randomly drawn jury then cross-examines it on a fresh zephyr of unpredictable prompts, and its answers must hold one consistent pearl of reasoning across rounds. A thread of near-identical phrasing across several identities lets the jury cluster them and slash the whole cluster. Cost to the attacker: a distinct bond and a distinct consistent persona per fake, while one detection seizes every bond in the cluster.
